blocks.text: PARIS, France—Pope Leo XIV on Saturday celebrated an open-air mass in front of hundreds of thousands of faithful in Paris. The event came after the pontiff rode in the popemobile along the iconic Champs Elysees to the cheers of vast crowds clutching French and Vatican flags. The leader of the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics is on a four-day trip to France, a secular country with deep Catholic roots, with his trip stirring enthusiasm and spiritual fervor among the faithful.
